defaults.composition: A broad sideways view across the orchard or garden: fresh grass and early blooms in the foreground, tree crowns or beds spread across the middle ground, soft hills or a woodland edge in the background, with tree rows and beds running sideways across the frame

shots.subject: A hillside apple orchard in early bloom, old trees with white and pale pink blossom, fresh grass between them, a low dry-stone wall and a beech woodland edge beyond
shots.motion_elements: the blossoming branches and the grass
